artifact.summary: Abstained: the specification does not define the cyclic generator U (gate order, CZ coupling pattern, cycle structure), which is the only part that would be a quantum operation. A guessed H/CZ generator would not be a faithful reconstruction. A simple H/CZ power already fails for n=1, where H^2 = I gives only 2 of the 3 MUBs, so a phase gate or other ingredient is clearly missing from the placeholder form. No code is emitted.

equation_mapping.explanation: Standard definition of mutual unbiasedness. It would be a verification criterion for a generated basis set, not a circuit operation.
Standard result on the size of a complete MUB set (d+1 bases for d=2^n). It is context only and implies no gates.
Schematic cyclic generation. The cycle structure, any relabeling or permutation, and whether one cycle covers all bases are unspecified, so it cannot be implemented without inventing details.
The spec itself labels this H/CZ generator form as an assumption with an assumed gate order and coupling pattern c_ij. Implementing it would present a placeholder as the paper's construction.
Classical linear-inversion post-processing of measured probabilities. It is not a unitary circuit operation, and the task excludes measurement and reconstruction.

unresolved_issues: Explicit generator U (gate order, CZ coupling pattern c_ij, and any single-qubit phase gates beyond H) is not given.
Cycle structure and how U-powers cover all d+1 bases are not specified.
Entanglement classes for 3- and 4-qubit complete MUB sets are not specified.
No public validation contract or requested instance was supplied to narrow the scope to a checkable construction.
